metadata.title: Utility Professional Seed: High-Volume Readiness
metadata.notes: Foundational certifications for high-volume entry-level employment.

nodes.title: Google IT Support Professional Certificate
nodes.description: Technical support fundamentals, computer networking, operating systems, system administration, and security. The industry standard for entry-level IT roles.

nodes.title: Salesforce Certified Associate
nodes.description: Foundational knowledge of the Salesforce platform. CRM usage, data integrity, and business reporting. Mapping value topology to enterprise CRM.

nodes.title: Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate
nodes.description: Foundations of digital marketing and advertising on Meta platforms. Creating ads, campaign management, and reporting.

nodes.title: ServSafe Food Handler
nodes.description: Essential food safety for front-line workers. Basic hygiene, cleaning and sanitizing, and time/temperature control.

nodes.title: Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)
nodes.description: Foundational project management knowledge. Understanding the lifecycle, terminology, and processes of project coordination.

edges.rationale: The Cryptographic Mind provides the necessary intuition for Google IT security domains.
SME bookkeeping intuition maps directly to CRM data management and reporting.
Microbial sanitation mastery covers 90% of the ServSafe Food Handler syllabus.
